title: EV PDF Codes Adapter — Output Schema
description: Schema for every JSON file produced by ev-pdf-codes-adapter. Each file covers one section of one PDF (e.g. EVB.pdf → EVB.json). The importer reads one file per section and imports all records[] into the database.

schema_version.description: Shared envelope schema version. Importer should reject files it does not recognise.

schema_type.description: Always 'shared_document_profile'. Identifies this as the shared document envelope format.

document_id.description: SHA-256 hex of the raw PDF file bytes. Computed by shared/document_id.py. Stable across re-runs on the same file. Use this to deduplicate on re-runs and to join records from different adapters that processed the same PDF.

source_file.description: Filename of the source PDF (no directory path). Example: 'EVB.pdf'.

metadata.description: Raw PDF metadata as stored by the publisher. All fields may be null.

creator.description: Application that created the PDF, e.g. 'FrameMaker 7.1'.

pdf_profile.description: Properties of the PDF that affect extraction reliability.

pdf_type.description: Gate field. 'digital' = native text layer present, extraction ran. 'scanned' = no text layer, records[] will be empty.

is_digital.description: True when the PDF has a native text layer. Mirrors pdf_type == 'digital'.

needs_ocr.description: Always false for digital PDFs. Reserved for when an OCR pipeline is added.

has_links.description: Whether the PDF contains any hyperlinks.

has_internal_links.description: Whether the PDF has internal navigation links. The adapter uses these to map DTC codes to pages. If false, page assignment used Y-position fallback (lower confidence).

vehicle.description: Vehicle identity extracted from the PDF. Every record in the database is tagged with these values.

year.description: Model year as a string, e.g. '2013'. Null if not detected.

make.description: Manufacturer name, e.g. 'Nissan'. Resolved via shared/vehicle_lookup.json.

variant.description: Trim or variant if the manual covers more than one, e.g. '24kWh'. Usually null.

revision_date.description: Manual revision date as printed, e.g. 'October 2013'.

source.description: How and where vehicle info was extracted. Use confidence to decide whether to trust or flag for review.

method.description: Detection method used to find vehicle info.

pdf_page.description: PDF page number (1-based) where vehicle info was found.

page_ref.description: Printed page label where vehicle info was found, e.g. 'EVB-1'.

section.description: The manual section this file covers. Namespaces all records.

code.description: Section codes present in this file, in order of first appearance. Single-section PDFs: one entry e.g. ["EVB"]. Merged PDFs: all sections e.g. ["GI", "EVB", "AV"]. Null if no section codes detected.

name.description: Human-readable section name. Not yet extracted — always null.

manual_type.description: Which physical manual this section came from when one PDF contains multiple manuals (TYPE 1, TYPE 2, etc.). Null when not detected.

adapter_name.description: Always 'ev-pdf-codes-adapter'. Importer uses this to route to the right import logic.

adapter_schema_version.description: Version of the adapter-specific payload schema (records[] shape). Separate from the shared schema_version.

extraction_status.description: Machine-readable outcome. Importer acts on this field, never on errors[] strings.

extraction_completed.description: True when extraction finished without a fatal error. False means records[] may be incomplete — check errors[].

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when extraction finished.

errors.description: Fatal or near-fatal errors from this run. Empty array when clean. Importer should log these and flag the file for investigation.

records.description: All DTC records extracted from this section. One record per DTC code group. Empty when no codes were found or pdf_type is 'scanned'.

record.description: One DTC diagnostic record. May cover multiple codes when Nissan groups them on the same pages.

record_id.description: Stable 16-character hex ID for this record. Derived from document_id + page range. Same record_id across re-runs = safe to upsert.

codes.description: DTC codes this record covers, e.g. ['P0A0D'] or ['P3032','P3033','P3034']. Primary lookup key for the whole system.

title.description: Human-readable title as printed in the manual, e.g. 'P0A0D HV SYSTEM INTERLOCK ERROR'. Useful for display and quick triage.

manual_type.description: Which TYPE N manual this record belongs to when the PDF contains multiple manuals (e.g. 'TYPE 1'). Omitted when not detected.

location.description: Where in the PDF this record was found.

start_pdf_page.description: First PDF page (1-based) of this record.

end_pdf_page.description: Last PDF page (1-based) of this record.

page_refs.description: Printed page labels spanning this record, e.g. ['EVB-88', 'EVB-89']. More stable than PDF page numbers if the PDF is ever re-exported.

section_code.description: Section code for this record, e.g. 'EVB'. Matches section.code at the top level.

sections.description: Text content of this record, split by heading. Each section is one embeddable chunk. Ordered as they appear in the PDF.

tables.description: Structured tables extracted from this record. Each table is linked to a section via section_id. raw_rows is always the source of truth.

table_groups.description: Tables that span multiple pages, merged into one logical table. Empty in most records. Each entry references the constituent table_ids.

images.description: Images extracted from this record's pages. Each image is saved as a file in the images/ subfolder. Linked to a section via section_id.

notes.description: Non-fatal extraction notes, e.g. 'merged 2 tables across pages'. Audit trail — importer may log these.

status.description: success = fully extracted. partial = extracted with warnings. failed = error during extraction. skipped = deliberately not processed.

ocr_used.description: Always false for digital PDFs. Will be true once OCR pipeline is added.

warnings.description: Per-record warnings. Importer may flag affected records for review.

section_block.description: One headed section of a DTC record. This is the primary unit for embedding — embed cleaned_text per section, tagged with role.

section_id.description: ID unique within this record, e.g. 'r1_s2'. Tables and images reference this to indicate which section they belong to.

heading.description: Section heading as printed in the manual. Known values: 'DTC Logic', 'DTC Confirmation Procedure', 'Diagnosis Procedure', 'Component Inspection', 'Description', 'Power Supply and Ground Circuit'.

role.description: Semantic role of this section. Use this to weight embeddings differently, route to different DB columns, or build targeted retrieval prompts. dtc_logic = fault detection table. dtc_confirmation_procedure = steps to reproduce the fault. diagnosis_procedure = repair/inspection steps. component_inspection = standalone component test. description = general overview.

oem_content_id.description: Nissan INFOID — OEM content block identifier, e.g. 'INFOID:0000000008745933'. Null for DTC Confirmation Procedure sections (Nissan design — that section shares the preceding block's INFOID). Null for non-Nissan manuals. The adapter reports exactly what the PDF says — it does NOT inherit or carry forward the previous section's INFOID.

cleaned_text.description: Extracted and noise-filtered prose text for this section. Sidebar labels stripped, hyphenation repaired. This is the field to embed for semantic search. Note: for sections that contain tables, the table content also appears here as flat text — use tables[] for structured access to the same data.

page_start.description: PDF page number (1-based) where this section starts.

page_end.description: PDF page number (1-based) where this section ends.

has_type_variants.description: Present and true when the section text contains [TYPE N] markers indicating variant-specific content paths.

type_markers_detected.description: The [TYPE N] markers found in this section, e.g. ['[TYPE 1]', '[TYPE 2]']. Only present when has_type_variants is true.

table_block.description: One table extracted from a record. raw_rows is always the source of truth. reconstructed_rows is a normalised version when present.

table_id.description: ID unique within this record, e.g. 'r1_t1'.

section_id.description: The section this table belongs to. Matches a section_id in sections[]. Null if the table could not be assigned to a section.

heading_nearby.description: Heading of the nearest section above this table. Convenience copy of the parent section's heading.

role.description: Semantic role inherited from the parent section. Same enum as section_block.role.

start_pdf_page.description: First PDF page (1-based) of this table.

end_pdf_page.description: Last PDF page (1-based) of this table.

page_refs.description: Printed page labels spanning this table.

raw_rows.description: Raw table rows as extracted from the PDF. Always preserved — never modified. Source of truth. Each row is an array of cell strings. First row(s) are headers — see extraction.header_rows_hint.

reconstructed_rows.description: Normalised version of the table after repair (e.g. merged cell deduplication). Only present when reconstruction.reconstructed is true. Use raw_rows as source of truth — this is a convenience view.

reconstruction.description: Present only when reconstructed_rows was produced.

reconstructed.description: True when normalisation was applied and reconstructed_rows is present.

source_of_truth.description: Always 'raw_rows'. Reminds the importer which field to trust.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the table structure. high = clean extraction. medium = some repair applied, verify if important. low = structure uncertain, use raw_rows only.

quality_flags.description: Machine-readable quality signals. Empty = clean. Known flags: 'outer_column_recovered' (leftmost column reconstructed from context), 'merged_cell_dedup' (merged cells normalised), 'reconstructed_rows_present' (normalised rows available), 'blob_row_stripped' (image placeholder row removed), 'multi_row_header' (header spans multiple rows), 'partial_header' (header detection uncertain).

header_rows_hint.description: How many leading rows are headers. Skip these when embedding and when displaying data rows. 0 = no header detected.

partial.description: Present and true when header detection is uncertain (e.g. 3+ level headers). Treat this table with extra caution.

table_group.description: A logical table formed by merging two or more tables that continue across pages.

group_id.description: ID unique within this record, e.g. 'r1_tg1'.

table_ids.description: The constituent table_ids that were merged, in page order.

merged_rows.description: Combined rows from all constituent tables, header deduplicated.

image_block.description: One image extracted from a record page. The image file is saved in the images/ subfolder alongside the JSON.

image_id.description: ID unique within this record, e.g. 'r1_i1'.

section_id.description: Section this image belongs to, assigned by page position. Matches a section_id in sections[]. Null when the image could not be assigned.

pdf_page.description: PDF page (1-based) the image was extracted from.

page_ref.description: Printed page label for this image's page, e.g. 'EVB-89'.

image_path.description: Filename of the saved image file, relative to the JSON file's directory. Example: 'EVB-89-img1.png'. Load it from the images/ subfolder next to the JSON.

caption.description: Caption or identifier found in text immediately below/above the image, e.g. 'JPCIA0347ZZ'. Nissan uses alphanumeric image IDs as captions. Null when not detected.

role.description: Semantic role of the image. Currently always 'unknown' — role classification not yet implemented.
